governing_plan: TP59-A01 revision 2026-10-16.1 sections 1-8 (Cycle #59 Attempt #1, BAT-730 bounded complete retained personnel evidence contribution to BAT-411/BAT-415)
purpose: One immutable, create-only national personnel evidence release over every retained season-roster membership 2004-2022 (154,387), a safe keyed disposition for every nonadmitted row (52,386), every retained returning-production transition 2015-2022 (982) and component (5,867) recomputed independently over canonical player sets, and the complete accepted-parent 2016-2022 FBS/FCS program-season census (1,760) with every unsupported or ambiguous identity and time state, served read-only by the installed bas-personnel-evidence-query. Honest gaps and unsupported states are results.

research_authority.permits: projecting, qualifying and joining the retained admitted, quarantined and research inputs into an UNTRUSTED_SHADOW retrospective personnel evidence release and recomputing the frozen returning production formulas
does_not: acquire any source, archive or provider row or reclassify a source
admit any record as PIT evidence, extend or backcast the parent's development-only admission or infer an effective day
infer game availability, depth, starter, snap, injury, eligibility, transfer order or a transfer episode from season membership
promote or merge a nonadmitted row, borrow current names, fuzzy-match names or join equal numeric IDs across namespaces
claim roster completeness, national completeness, recruiting/transfer completeness or 2023-2025 rosters
fit, tune or evaluate a model, create composite weights or materialize target-game features
complete BAT-411, BAT-415 or any other owner scope, or mutate or activate a predecessor
research_authority.committed_before: this contract is committed on the assignment branch before the first canonical write

grains.memberships: one record per admitted parent row (membership_key = observation_id)
grains.exclusions: one record per nonadmitted quarantine row (exclusion_key = observation_id)
grains.summaries: one record per retained team transition (<target_season>|<canonical_team_id>)
grains.witnesses: one record per pinned input (INPUT|<name>) and parent contract (CONTRACT|<path>)

ordering.memberships: season, canonical_player_id, canonical_team_id, observation_id (the parent's order)
ordering.witnesses: the contract's input order, then the parent contracts in contract order

layout.serialization: canonical JSON lines (sorted keys, separators ',' ':', UTF-8, no ASCII escaping); one zlib level-9 block per table segment (season) in the database; no separate payload files

ddl: CREATE TABLE meta (key TEXT NOT NULL, value TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE blocks (ord INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, record_table TEXT NOT NULL, segment TEXT NOT NULL, records INTEGER NOT NULL, first_key TEXT, last_key TEXT, lines_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, block BLOB NOT NULL)

identity_documents.identity: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON bytes of the document; compared as canonical bytes, never by Python equality (13.0, booleans and extra members differ)
identity_documents.location: <root>/canonical/national_personnel_evidence_2004_2022/sha256/<database identity>/national_personnel_evidence.sqlite; manifest at <root>/manifests/national_personnel_evidence_2004_2022/sha256/<database identity>/run_manifest.json with members identity, identity_document, content_identity, content_document and provenance; create-only (identical rebuild ALREADY_PRESENT_IDENTICAL, differing bytes REFUSED_IMMUTABLE_COLLISION)

layout.checkpoint_unit: one season (2004-2022): its memberships, exclusions, program-seasons and the summaries and components of that target season; witnesses and the census follow

returning.grain: CANONICAL_TEAM_OFFSEASON_TRANSITION (same canonical team, prior season to target season)
returning.roster_sets: distinct canonical_player_id of admitted season memberships per (season, canonical_team_id); a player on several teams counts once on each team, never twice on one
returning.common_support: prior-season roster, target-season roster and prior-season admitted player metrics for the same canonical team
returning.rate_arithmetic: IEEE-754 binary64 quotient of the two integers (Python float division), as the original
returning.numerator: sum of prior-season source_value over metric rows of the team, category and stat whose canonical player is in the returning set
returning.denominator: sum of prior-season source_value over every metric row of the team, category and stat
returning.share: numerator / denominator (binary64 quotient); a denominator <= 0 is null, never a share; a pair with no prior-season metric row is absent (no component) and its summary share is null, never zero

semantics.BOUNDED_NONNEGATIVE_COUNT_SHARE: interceptions INT, receiving REC, rushing CAR: must stay within [0,1]
semantics.SIGNED_EVENT_SUM_RATIO: passing YDS, receiving YDS, rushing YDS: kept unclipped; outside_unit_interval marks values below 0 or above 1

returning.partial: prior season 2020 (the partial player-metric source season) marks the 2020->2021 transition partial
returning.source_known_at: maximum source_known_at_utc over both rosters and the prior-season metrics of the team
returning.composite: none: passing and receiving yards overlap and no empirical weights are predeclared
returning.original_identity: feature_identity / component_identity recomputed exactly as the original research did (SHA-256 of sorted-key, ',' ':' separated, ASCII-escaped JSON without NaN) over the original members; equality with the retained original is reported, never forced

chain.entity_source: BAT-387 core registry rows record_type ENTITY, entity_type team, source_system_id SRC-002
chain.identity_key: TEAM|SRC-002|<cfbd_team_id> (exact namespace; SRC-001 SOURCE_MAPPING keys are ESPN evidence and never join)
chain.season_uniqueness: two program-seasons of one season whose chains name the same canonical team are both AMBIGUOUS_CANONICAL_TEAM_SHARED_IN_SEASON

census.source: both participants of every contest row of the accepted parent population 2016-2022 (every disposition, kept as witnesses) whose own source division label is FBS or FCS
census.key: unique (season, team_key org:<ncaa_org_id>); every name, division, contest and disposition kept
census.division_conflict: a key seen with both FBS and FCS is DIVISION_CONFLICT with both divisions kept
census.never: a delivered-row denominator, national completeness, an earlier NCAA denominator or 2023-2025 rows
census.roster_presence: count of admitted memberships of the chain's canonical team and season; presence is not completeness; null when the chain is not qualified (unknown, never zero)
census.transition_presence: a returning summary with this target season and canonical team

selectors.season: an integer; the grain's audited seasons (membership/exclusion 2004-2022, coverage 2016-2022, returning target 2015-2022, witness capture seasons); any other season serves no row with SEASON_OUTSIDE_RELEASE
selectors.team: an exact canonical team ID team_<32 lowercase hex>; membership: canonical_team_id; exclusion: the retained nullable canonical_team_id (never an admitted association); coverage: the qualified chain's canonical team; returning grains: canonical_team_id
selectors.program: an exact source-qualified program org:<1-12 digits> (bare digits read as org:<digits>); coverage: team_key; membership: the census association; returning grains: the target season's census association; no names
selectors.player: an exact canonical player ID player_<32 lowercase hex>; membership: canonical_player_id; exclusion: the retained nullable canonical_player_id
selectors.paging: --limit (default 50, non-negative), --offset (non-negative) or --all; exact totals in record order
selectors.intersection: selectors intersect; an unknown or disjoint valid selection serves no row (transition coverage included); malformed or inapplicable selectors are refused before any file is read
selectors.pit: --require-pit is always refused; no historical as-of selector is offered

refusals.stderr: one JSON object with members refused (the code) and error (the text); nothing on stdout

scope.population: all 154,387 retained admitted season memberships and 52,386 nonadmitted rows 2004-2022, all 982 retained returning transitions 2015-2022 with their 5,867 components, and every accepted-parent 2016-2022 FBS/FCS program-season
scope.horizon: retrospective research on a May 2023 source; no PIT, forecast, availability, depth, starter, injury, eligibility, transfer episode, recruiting completeness or predictive skill
scope.not_audited: 2023-2025 and current rosters, an earlier NCAA program denominator, lower divisions, and every other personnel domain (recruiting/transfer histories, availability, player value)
